name: Soleur Infra
description: Terraform's Tier-B GitHub identity (#8209, ADR-241). It manages the CI policy substrate, the deployment environments and the Actions secrets of the jikig-ai org's own repositories. Since #9262 it also serves two non-Terraform consumers on the main-only infra-privileged environment: the inngest-bootstrap pin bump (opens and auto-merges the pin PR) and the auto-mint build dispatch. It has no runtime surface, no active webhook and no end-user installation.
